decisions.reason: Garage door operators complement the core door range, are featured on a dedicated page, and cost little to keep while market uncertainty resolves after only one year.
The solid wood sectional door is a niche variant with only a mention, but one year reveals too little to justify abandoning an option that is cheap to keep within a customizable range.
A remote-controlled operator is a standard accessory that fits the one-source offering, and keeping it open costs little.
Glazed industrial sectional doors share a production platform with related models, so keeping the option costs little despite overlap with Product F.
The insulated glazed version answers energy-efficiency requirements and offers distinct value that is still uncertain, so the option stays open.
Its dedicated page signals commitment, and early results give no evidence that justifies abandoning it.
